canonical_title: Pitch and roll coupling for target acquisition and tracking

versions.title_at_revision: Pitch and roll coupling for target acquisition and tracking
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's pitch and roll coupling in hover and low airspeed (up to 45 KGS) for target acquisition and tracking is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities as specified in MIL- DTL-32742, Pitch due to Roll and Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Target Acquisition and Tracking paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the pitch due to roll and roll due to pitch coupling for target acquisition and tracking as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Pitch due to Roll and Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Target Acquisition and Tracking paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Frequency response data generated for forward flight pitch and roll bandwidth can be used to assess compliance provided off-axis control inputs are minimized and uncorrelated with the on-axis sweep. Multi-input FFT analysis methods are required to obtain the correct off-axis frequency responses necessary to evaluate against this standard. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the pitch due to roll and roll due to pitch coupling for target acquisition and tracking as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Pitch due to Roll and Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Target Acquisition and Tracking paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Frequency response data generated for forward flight pitch and roll bandwidth can be used to assess compliance provided off-axis control inputs are minimized and uncorrelated with the on-axis sweep. Multi-input FFT analysis methods are required to obtain the correct off-axis frequency responses necessary to evaluate against this standard. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test and piloted simulation and evaluation using models that are updated with flight test results to assess the pitch due to roll and roll due to pitch coupling for target acquisition and tracking as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Pitch due to Roll and Roll due to Pitch Coupling for Target Acquisition and Tracking paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Frequency response data generated for forward flight pitch and roll bandwidth can be used to assess compliance provided off-axis control inputs are minimized and uncorrelated with the on-axis sweep. Multi-input FFT analysis methods are required to obtain the correct off-axis frequency responses necessary to evaluate against this standard.
